---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem
---

## What happened

Describe the result and what you expected.

## Reproduce

List the steps and affected entry or book links. Include browser, OS, device,
app/library version from Settings, and whether this is an installed app.
For offline or update problems, include network state and the previous version.

## Evidence

Attach relevant errors or screenshots. Avoid personal data and copyrighted book scans.
